description:
AUDIT 2026-10-27 (owner-adjudicated, advisor-reviewed): the acceptance and context sections supersede this description wherever they differ. Historical text below is kept for reference.

First real PyPI release on the new path. The TestPyPI rehearsal moved to dlv2-52a-testpypi-rehearsal (2026-10-17 adversarial review: codex Required + claude F9(3) implemented as a tracker split, not a design note). This item keeps the dlv2-22 gate: a green nightly T3 run is required before a real PyPI release, and no part of this item may be rehearsed around that gate.

Agent (pre-approved): run make release-prep VERSION=0.5.0, merge the release-prep PR, wait for its trunk.yml push run on develop to finish green, then STOP: report readiness (rehearsal evidence from dlv2-52a, candidate commit, hashes) to the owner. EXPECTED STOP: the owner creates the annotated v0.5.0 tag (git tag -a; lightweight tags are refused) and approves the pypi environment deployment. The owner hand-off window must be stated and kept well inside the 90-day artifact retention; GitHub cancels deployments waiting for approval after 30 days (claude NEW-12). After the owner's release, the agent verifies hashes against the admitted SHA256SUMS, attestation with the expected signer workflow, and pypi-latest installability (t3:install), then finishes the item.

Authority note (claude NEW-3, accepted): agents share the owner account (ADR D4); the v-tag bypass actor and pypi environment (can_admins_bypass true, prevent_self_review false) do not mechanically stop the agent account. The STOP above is enforced by agent discipline, and the publish-time tag re-check in dlv2-51 is the machine control. State this plainly in the readiness report; do not describe the ruleset or environment as a human gate that binds the agent.

Guardrails: never rebuild; never fall back to an older trunk run; no trunk reruns on the tagged commit; every pypi publish needs the owner's approval in this item, every time.
